slides.title: So, what is the 200-week average?
paras: Average Bitcoin's last 200 weekly closes (about 4 years). Today: near <g>$68,200</g>. Bitcoin: about $64.5K, 5% under.
slides.source: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD weekly closes, own calculation

slides.title: The last 2 times it broke the line
What happened next?
paras: Both times Bitcoin was higher a year later. But in 2022 it first fell another 21%. Past data, not a forecast.

sources: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD weekly closes Sep 2014 to Nov 17 2026; 200-week simple average computed: $68,184 (week of Nov 16 2026), below since week of Nov 9 2026
CoinDesk via AlphaMaven (Nov 13 2026): BTC fell below $68,000 and the 200-week average; Hotcoin X post Nov 17: 200-week average ~$68K

Prior breaks: Mar 9 2020 close $5,392 (MA $5,533), back above Mar 16; Jun 13 2022 close $20,553 (MA $22,379), lowest Nov 14 2022 $16,292 (-32.2%), back above Mar 13 2023 ($28,039); 1y later: Mar 8 2021 $59,302, Jun 12 2023 $26,336
